rule.statement: An interim injunction can be granted to prevent a party from placing or putting into possession of a building, which would jeopardize the interests of the other party in the process of recovering monies due to them.
rule.supporting_quote: The objective of the Plaintiff in seeking an interim injunction has been to prevent the Defendant from placing or putting into possession of the building 3rd parties which would jeopardize the interests of the Plaintiff in the process of the recovery of the monies due to them which is apparent from the documents that had been filed by the Plaintiff and in taking steps in pursuing with their action based on the breach of agreements and securing their rights in respect of the mortgage bond.
